# ffish.js (ffish-es6 0.7.10)

The chess-variant rules of [Fairy-Stockfish](https://github.com/fairy-stockfish/Fairy-Stockfish) compiled to WebAssembly,
by Fabian Fichter, Johannes Czech and the Fairy-Stockfish contributors. GPL-3.0, unmodified copy of the npm package
[ffish-es6](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ffish-es6). Source: https://github.com/fairy-stockfish/Fairy-Stockfish/tree/master/tests/js

AI Chess uses it for move generation, notation and game results in the variants; the moves themselves come from the
Fairy-Stockfish engine, the variant bot or an AI model.
